question: Which two methods are available to manage an ACI REST API session authentication when a user is unauthenticated? (Choose two.)
theory: Before a session exists, only two ACI REST calls are meaningful: GET to aaaListDomains (which lists available AAA login domains so the client knows which one to authenticate against) and POST to aaaLogin (which submits credentials and returns a session token/cookie). aaaRefresh and aaaLogout both operate on an already-established session, so they cannot be used by an unauthenticated user. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 16 — Automation and Scripting Tools)
